title: Repeated authentication failures
why_it_fired: Observed 5 failed authentications for user 'soc_test_attacker' from 127.0.0.1 within 5 minutes; threshold is 5.
rule_threshold: 5 failures / 5 minutes / same user + source IP
recommended_actions: Verify whether the source and target user are expected.
Check adjacent authentication events and endpoint telemetry.
If unauthorized, block or rate-limit the source through approved controls and reset affected credentials.
